insights.summary: Palantir reported FY2025 revenue of $3,640 million (full-year) with net income of $797 million, but the 10-K filing is predominantly risk-focused, containing extensive disclosure of regulatory, competitive, and operational headwinds. The company faces significant challenges from evolving AI regulation (EU AIA, state-level oversight), expanding privacy/data protection laws globally (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, NIS2), reliance on government contracts vulnerable to budget cycles and political changes, and intense competition. Management emphasizes defensive positioning around culture, customer values alignment, and non-China operations rather than forward growth initiatives.
